title: Chocolate and Strawberry Pizza

ingredientGroups.title: Ingredients
items: ½–1 lb strawberries, cleaned and chopped
Optional: 2 Tbsp milk, cream, or condensed milk

steps: Fire the oven to pizza heat and shape the dough.
Sprinkle grated chocolate over the dough and add the strawberries.
Cook about 2 minutes, until the rim is browned and chocolate melted.
Optionally blend the chocolate with 2 Tbsp milk or cream for a milder topping, or condensed milk for a sweeter topping.
